title: Conditional types, mapped types, and template literals — concept map
intro: T extends U ? X : Y, infer extraction, mapped types with key remapping, template literal types, and distributive conditional pitfalls.

overviewDiagram.title: Conditional type evaluation
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  T[Type parameter T] --> D{Naked union?}
  D -->|yes| DIST[Distribute per member]
  D -->|no| COND[T extends U ? X : Y]
  DIST --> R[Union of branch results]
  COND --> INFER[infer in extends clause]

conceptCards.title: Conditional types
conceptCards.summary: T extends U ? X : Y. Exclude, Extract, NonNullable built on this. Compile-time only.
conceptCards.example: type NonNullable<T> = T extends null | undefined ? never : T

conceptCards.title: infer keyword
conceptCards.summary: Capture type in extends clause. ReturnType, Parameters, Awaited implementations.
conceptCards.example: T extends (...args: never[]) => infer R ? R : never

conceptCards.title: Mapped types
conceptCards.summary: Transform keys and values. Partial, Record, Pick. Key remapping with as clause.

conceptCards.title: Template literal types
conceptCards.summary: String manipulation at type level. Event names, CSS keys, route paths.

conceptCards.title: Distributive conditionals
conceptCards.summary: Naked union T distributes. [T] wrap disables. Exclude filters union members.
conceptCards.example: T extends U ? never : T over union
